## 主张 Claim

同一事件法则中的保留／解除耦合描述具有相同单项可能性，但前者保留全部所表示共同组合并新增完整共同组合。该结构输出接入明确比较原则 C 后，任何完全由这些单项可能性决定的摘要上的非自反比较都无法实现 C；共同组合描述能区分此例，丰富可能性仍不强迫实际共同实现。 / Under one event law, retaining and releasing a coupling have identical marginal possibilities, while retention preserves every represented joint bundle and adds the full bundle. Feeding this structural output into explicit comparison principle C excludes any irreflexive comparator over a summary fully determined by those marginals. A joint-bundle description distinguishes the case; richer possibility still does not force joint actualization.

Canonical source: [RelationalGrounding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RelationalGrounding.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 复用 JointContinuationClassification 的共同初始配置、事件法则及稳定的活动含义；这些是局部关系表示，不是从零导出的普遍物理学。 / Reuses JointContinuationClassification's common initial configuration, event law and stable claim meanings; these supply a local relational representation, not a universal physics derived from nothing.
- 比较阻碍定理明确假定 GenerativeComparison.ComparisonPrinciple C 的此项应用；标为 generative 的仅是含全部两个所表示实现的组合，不能以该标签证明其正面意义。 / The comparison obstruction explicitly assumes this application of GenerativeComparison.ComparisonPrinciple C. Only a bundle containing both represented realizations is marked generative; the label does not warrant its favorable meaning.
- 摘要仅由全部单项可能性决定，且摘要比较非自反；不要求可加总分、全排序或传递性。 / The summary is determined solely by all marginal possibilities and its comparator is irreflexive; additive scores, totality and transitivity are not required.
- 伦理应用仍需说明该实际共同能力如何实现生生的正面可能性，并完整涵盖相关成本、损失与其他变化。 / Ethical application still requires warrant that the actual joint capacity realizes a favorable living possibility and adequately covers relevant costs, losses and other changes.

先有同一展开中耦合关系的保留与解除，左／右是其中分化的位置。jointInventory.realized 表示共同能力实际成立而非所有未来结果已经发生。形式组合直接以尚未单独迁移的 JointContinuationClassification 输出，满足尚未单独迁移的 GenerativeComparison 中 C 的输入；并未导入一般实践判断或 AI 方向模块。 / Retention and release concern a coupling within one unfolding; left and right are differentiated positions within it. jointInventory.realized denotes an actually present joint capacity, not all future outcomes having happened. The formal composition directly uses outputs of the unmigrated JointContinuationClassification module as inputs to C in the unmigrated GenerativeComparison module; it does not import the general practical-judgment or AI-direction modules.

With no premise the core proves that a comparison read off a description of configurations, comparing no description with itself, satisfies C only if the description tells every extension apart from its base (Comparison.separates). An inventory is a frame with no moves (Frame.ofInventory); retaining the coupling extends releasing it with the same marginal possibilities, so strict_comparison_cannot_factor_through_marginals is that law's instance here (strict_comparison_through_marginals_by_core), with empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope; the bridge now imports RelationalGrounding, which the spine run compiles as an inherited module.
